parts.t: Sardis South

blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Sardis South

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Sardis South are served by Watson Elementary, Unsworth Elementary, Mt. Slesse Middle School (5871 Tyson Road), Vedder Middle, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Watson Glen Park (pump track, skate park, sports fields), Sardis Sports Complex (three ice rinks at 5725 Tyson Road), Sardis Library (5819 Tyson Road), andCheam Leisure Centre nearby. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder Road), Route 58 (Tyson Road loop), and connections to UFV Chilliwack campus and Cottonwood Mall.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Sardis South

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Sardis South are regulated by the Sardis Neighbourhood Plan and South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan under the Chilliwack 2050 OCP, plus Vedder River Alluvial Fan flood construction level requirements. Before removing subjects on a property in Sardis South, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

Which schools serve Sardis South in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Sardis South include Watson Elementary, Unsworth Elementary, Mt. Slesse Middle School (5871 Tyson Road), Vedder Middle, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Sardis South?

Residents of Sardis South have access to Watson Glen Park (pump track, skate park, sports fields), Sardis Sports Complex (three ice rinks at 5725 Tyson Road), Sardis Library (5819 Tyson Road), andCheam Leisure Centre nearby. See our
Sardis South Neighbourhood Guide

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Sardis South?

Key road corridors serving Sardis South include Vedder Road, Watson Road, Tyson Road, South Sumas Road, and Keith Wilson Road. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder Road), Route 58 (Tyson Road loop), and connections to UFV Chilliwack campus and Cottonwood Mall.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Sardis South?

Properties in Sardis South are governed by the Sardis Neighbourhood Plan and South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan under the Chilliwack 2050 OCP, plus Vedder River Alluvial Fan flood construction level requirements. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Sardis South freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Sardis South are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
